findings.issue: Derived values are not bound to the record's recall and representation: (1) fromResult has no result/recall/view identity check, and ViewFingerprint.of never renders NodeSummary.propositional, so a twin view built with public NodeSummary.copy(propositional = Declared) keeps the fingerprint and yields Assessed; checked never compares link fidelity with MappingTarget.propositional; (2) ModelPosterior, MappingLink and TermSupportStatus carry no recall/view identity, so computed + checked accept values from an HsmmResult over a different recall sharing positional unit IDs (segmenter.scala:435); (3) the decoder checks only inventoryDigest and sourceDigest, never the DerivationContext, and the wire carries no recall_checksum/view_fingerprint; (4) a record mixing values from two HsmmResults is constructible and encodable but no single context re-decodes it, falsifying the total-encode premise.
findings.fix: One align-level derivation binding per record: AlignWire.recallChecksum(recall) plus ViewFingerprint.of(view) with a per-target propositional-scope digest, recorded in SourceRepresentation.of; fromResult checks result.recallChecksum and viewFingerprint (as CellCoordinates.of) and reads scope from the representation; every derived measure/link records its binding; checked refuses binding mismatch, more than one derivation source per record, and Assessed on a non-Declared target; recall_checksum and view_fingerprint on the wire as mandatory match fields; decoder checks context.recall against the inventory, context.view against the representation, result against both. Falsifiers: twin-view Assessed refuses in checked and decode; foreign-recall posterior with shared unit IDs refuses in checked; mixed-result record refuses.
